title: DATASPACE run
description: One round trip: a source conversation, a capsule written by a model (or by the offline engine), and the conversation rebuilt from the capsule alone, with the provenance of every call. The page exports runs in this shape (one run, or { schema, exported, runs: [...] }) and loads them back; measures are re-derived from the texts and compared with the stored snapshot. Bundled recorded files (runs-<preset>.json) hold { schema, preset, generatedAt, calls: { id: call }, runs: [run] }, where a run's provenance names its compress and rebuild calls by id.

kind.description: recorded = a stored model reply replayed; live = a reply from this session; engine = the offline extractive capsule, no model; imported = loaded from a file

preset.description: bundled conversation id, or null for the visitor's own text

source.description: the conversation exactly as sent to the compress call (bundled files omit it; the page takes it from the preset)

level.description: strength: 1 gentle (50% of the source's words) to 5 brutal (5%)

budgetWords.description: the word limit written into the compress prompt

rebuild.description: null when the rebuild did not run

route.description: ollama | own-key | worker | pollinations | offline, or the recorder's description

digest.description: Ollama model digest (first 12 hex) for recorded runs

promptVersion.description: the PROMPTS.version in config.js that produced the requests

compressCall.description: recorded runs: id of the compress call in the file's calls map

calls.description: exports of recorded runs carry their two calls verbatim (request body, raw reply, token counts, timings)

measures.description: measures.js snapshot(): srcBits, capBits, rate, fidelity, kept, dropped, invented, numbers, entities, turns, split

system.description: the exact system message, including llm.js's JSON line on JSON calls

usage.description: token counts when the route reports them

cached.description: possible when a public reply came back faster than CACHED_MS
